style_summary: Continues the near-to-far sports photography, giant white oblique type, near-black backgrounds and single-color haze, switching to tennis, still rings, speed skating and archery to show four force structures: net, ring, blade and bowstring.

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] Photographic athletic action uses an extreme near-to-far scale jump: one physically connected piece of equipment or body part dominates the foreground while the athlete recedes into depth.
[CORE] Monumental white heavyweight oblique sans-serif typography cuts through the composition; the athlete occludes selected letter areas without destroying the exact headline.
[CORE] A near-black edge field opens into a luminous single-hue atmospheric band behind the action, producing sharp white-type contrast and dark sculptural human form.
[CORE] Directional photographic motion softness and colored atmospheric streaks carry the force vector while the critical contact point or equipment retains selective detail.

[FLEX] Let each sport determine the spatial structure: a tennis string grid sweeping past the lens, a wooden ring anchoring a receding gymnast, a long thin skating blade slicing an ice plane, or a taut bowstring and recurved bow framing an archer. Continue the established series language while changing content and force geometry.
[FLEX] Place, rotate, stagger or stretch the type around the movement; protect complete headline comprehension while allowing scale, selected edge cropping, and controlled overlap.
[FLEX] Choose one dominant hue per case, with dark and pale related tones; hues may vary across the family.
[FLEX] Recompose subject, title and negative space independently for portrait and landscape, preserving the same case concept rather than cropping the other ratio.
source_content_to_avoid: The source Nike swoosh, Nike wordmark, JUST DO IT slogan and any recognizable sportswear brand logo.
The PEGASUS42 or PEGASUS 42 model wording and the reference advertising paragraph.
The white running shoe with a teal swoosh as a giant foreground product.
The exact front-facing male runner, lifted knee, grey long-sleeve top and black shorts combination.
The source arrangement of fragmented PEG, S42 and giant brand letters; do not trace its composition.
Part 1 content: track bicycle wheel, chalked climbing hand on rock, freestyle swimming hand, fencing blade, and the headlines BREAK AWAY, HOLD FAST, CUT THROUGH and STRIKE FIRST.
Part 2 content: raised basketball, snowboard underside, kayak paddle, boxing gloves, and the headlines RISE ABOVE, CARVE WILD, DRIVE DEEP and MAKE IMPACT.

visual_deconstruction.reference_observations: The supplied portrait uses a huge near-camera shoe, a receding runner, dark green-to-mint glow, monumental slanted white type and broad foreground speed softness. Small white copy acts as a calm secondary layer. These describe the source; exact product, brand, pose and type positions are not retained.
visual_deconstruction.reusable_system: Oppose an enlarged near contact point with a receding human figure and giant planar lettering; align haze and letter force with the case-specific movement.
visual_deconstruction.continuation_scope: Part 3 preserves the established visual identity across Parts 1 and 2. New sports, equipment geometries, materials and camera relationships replace every case; existing layouts are not traced.

composition.hierarchy: Near contact point or equipment first, athlete and movement second, monumental headline sharing the hero scale, small series label and single supporting line last.
composition.depth: Three overlapping planes: atmospheric field, white headline, photographic action, with selected foreground streaks passing in front.
composition.ratio_adaptation: Each case includes separate 9:16 and 16:9 plans. Rebalance scale and negative space rather than center-cropping.

typography.headline: Heavy geometric grotesk, uppercase, oblique or dynamically rotated, white, monumental, exactly spelled and readable as complete words despite selected occlusion.
typography.secondary: Small but clearly readable white sans-serif, slightly oblique optional; restrained case series and one supporting line; no body paragraph.
typography.copy_policy: Render only the three exact case strings, each once; line breaks are flexible but letters and punctuation are not.

color_palette.relationship: Near-black edges 35-50%, one luminous case hue 20-35%, white typography and lit photographic surfaces 20-35%; estimates are compositional guidance.

image_treatment.texture: Clean commercial photographic compositing without paper grain or halftone. Keep focal microtexture on carbon racket and taut strings, polished wood ring and chalked grip, honed skate blade and fine ice grooves, or a matte recurve bow and tensioned string. Broad directional blur belongs to passing surfaces and atmosphere; fine chalk or ice spray is localized to actual contact. Stable strength and aim use atmospheric depth softness rather than invented high-speed motion.
image_treatment.lighting: Sculptural hard/soft mixed lighting: dark athlete with bright rim and light on the near contact surface; light and haze share the case hue.

design_rules: Keep the foreground object physically connected to a coherent athlete and valid sporting action.
White lettering must function as a large spatial plane interacting with the movement.
Limit finished artwork to the three exact case text strings; do not add logos, pseudocopy or punctuation.
Maintain clean separation between sharp focal evidence and intentional directional softness.
Treat each case concept and each aspect ratio as a designed composition.
do: Check anatomy, contact and equipment continuity at full size.
Keep the headline readable and white type dominant at thumbnail scale.
Preserve atmospheric softness and useful quiet space.
Use sport-specific force geometry to distinguish the four cases.
avoid: Copying the source shoe, swoosh, slogan or runner pose.
Four interchangeable centered figures with only color or props changed.
Random particles, paper grain, fake film damage or decorative HUD graphics.
Overblurring the contact point, malformed hands, floating equipment or illegible headline.
negative_prompt: Nike logo, swoosh, PEGASUS42, JUST DO IT, original running-shoe hero, logo-like symbols, extra text, extra punctuation, watermark, QR code, duplicate limbs, disconnected equipment, fused fingers, fake sharpness, halftone, paper grain, random particles, busy stadium, border, poster mockup, small timid headline, unreadable headline, generic repeated layout, Part 1 sports or headlines, branded ball, printed snowboard underside, jersey number, chest emblem, glove logo, previous eight sports, basketball, snowboard, kayak, boxing gloves, extra racket, missing strings, broken straps, extra rings, duplicated skate runners, duplicated bowstring, disconnected arrow

values.SUBJECT: An adult female tennis player in plain graphite tennis clothing executing a powerful one-handed forehand, with her free arm used for balance. She holds one unmarked graphite tennis racket; a single yellow tennis ball approaches the string bed. The court is dark and sparse.
values.FOCAL_DETAIL: An oversized oval racket head and its taut regular string grid sweep close to the lens on the right foreground. The grip, shaft and player hand remain continuously connected. One yellow ball sits immediately at the string bed with slight plausible impact compression; only one racket and one ball. Keep a broad part of the grid and rim clearly visible.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Treat the transparent string bed as a spatial window rather than a solid prop; glimpse the receding athlete and white type through the mesh. Portrait: near racket head in lower-right, arm connects back to athlete upper-left; place TURN high and THE MATCH in a lower-left dark area, exact phrase readable in order. Landscape: giant racket at right, athlete reaching from left-middle, enormous three-word headline across the upper field with selected overlap. The racket ellipse and fine grid oppose monumental solid letter shapes.
values.PALETTE: Petroleum black, vivid electric teal and cool white, with a narrow teal light sweep following the racket arc. The tennis ball is a restrained yellow accent.

values.SUBJECT: An adult male gymnastics athlete in a plain dark sleeveless leotard and black trousers holding a controlled iron-cross position on two wooden still rings. Both arms extend sideways from the shoulders, one hand grips each ring, legs straight together and pointed feet below.
values.FOCAL_DETAIL: One large near-camera wooden ring with a chalked gripping hand dominates the left foreground. Natural five-digit grip encloses the lower side of the ring. Its woven strap is taut upward. The arm connects to the receding gymnast; the second hand grips a second smaller ring farther away, also attached to its own taut vertical strap. Exactly two rings and two suspension straps.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Use a near circular aperture and a suspended human cross as the force geometry. The still pose emphasizes tension, with a small chalk veil in warm light and otherwise controlled quiet atmosphere. Portrait: close ring at upper-left, connected arm leads to athlete center-right and legs drop into the lower dark zone; giant DEFY and GRAVITY inhabit opposite open areas with clear reading order. Landscape: near ring dominates left quarter, gymnast recedes center-right, far ring sits right edge within frame; white megatype fills upper negative space while legs descend below. No bent dangling limbs or a climbing-rock scene.
values.PALETTE: Near-black umber, glowing copper and warm ivory, with sculptural side light on wood grain, chalked skin and shoulder muscles.

values.SUBJECT: An adult female long-track speed skater in a plain dark graphite skinsuit, plain protective sport glasses and dark cap, leaning deeply through a racing turn on two long-bladed speed skates. Knees are bent and body is low; one arm is tucked behind the back and one extends laterally for balance.
values.FOCAL_DETAIL: A single near speed-skate boot and its long thin steel runner fill the lower foreground. The runner is mounted continuously below the boot with believable supporting brackets, making clean contact with the ice along its edge. The attached ankle and bent leg lead to the receding athlete, with a second skate on her other leg clearly separated. No extra blades or snowboard.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Make the thin metal runner a long cutting line across a broad ice plane; the athlete curves into the turn above it and faint ice grooves converge in depth. Portrait: blade cuts a lower-left to middle-right diagonal, skater occupies upper-right and the three-word headline steps through the left and upper open areas. Landscape: long near blade extends across lower foreground, skater recedes to right-center and huge title follows the upper-left arc. Keep the metal blade as hero evidence rather than a running-shoe product shot.
values.PALETTE: Midnight blue-black, pale ice blue and silver-white, with a concentrated cold luminous band at ice level and restrained blue motion haze.

values.SUBJECT: An adult female target archer in plain black fitted sportswear and a simple dark forearm guard, holding one unmarked matte-black recurve bow at full draw. One extended arm grips the bow while the other hand anchors the drawn string at her cheek. One arrow is nocked on the string and rests on the bow rest.
values.FOCAL_DETAIL: The near bow grip, naturally gripping hand and smooth recurved limbs are close to the camera, with a single tensioned string running from upper tip through the draw-hand anchor to lower tip. One straight arrow runs from its nock at the draw hand through the rest. Show coherent bow, string, hand and arrow relationships with no extra arrows or duplicated string.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Build a triangular tension space from the bowed limbs, straight arm and drawn string, with the arrow as a fine aiming line across a huge white type plane. The archer is concentrated and still; glow and depth softness convey stored force rather than a released arrow. Portrait: near bow rises along left foreground, archer recedes on right, STAY above and TRUE below the aiming line. Landscape: bow and gripping hand occupy left foreground, draw hand and face at right-center, headline spans upper dark space and the arrow stays almost horizontal below it. Keep the action a precise target-sport setup, with no person or target in the arrow path.
values.PALETTE: Near-black olive, luminous honey gold and bright warm white; a thin golden edge light traces bow and string against a dark uncluttered field.
